latestVersion.changelog:
ai-room-planner-openapi-skill v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Plan and redesign a room photo with a new interior design style using AI.
- Interact with the WeShop OpenAPI to start design runs, poll status, and upload images.
- Requires a WESHOP_API_KEY for secure HTTPS access (never share your key outside openapi.weshop.ai).
- Supports customizable interior style descriptions and batch output (1–16 images).
- Provides clear guidance on API key safety and usage setup.
